connect4.notes: No licence anywhere in the repository (no licence file, no headers, no README statement): all rights reserved, so it can't be redistributed.

rummy.notes: No licence anywhere in the repository: all rights reserved, so it can't be redistributed.

brickgame-4bit.notes: An emulator for a Brick Game handheld: it plays only a dump of the console's ROM, which is not free and can't be shipped.

katamascii.notes: Needs the Chipmunk physics engine, libcaca and GLib on top of curses; not ported in this round for the size and build cost of those libraries.

ascii-patrol.notes: Its Linux build reads the keyboard through X11 (Xi) and plays sound through PulseAudio, so it can't run in a terminal.

gnu-go.notes: Built for all three ABIs, but it stops with its internal "You stepped on a bug" error on the first move in this toolchain (musl, clang); not shipped until that's found.

gnu-chess.notes: Built, but its engine (a thread fed through pipes) never answers a move in the app's terminal; not shipped until that's found. nchess plays chess against a built-in engine meanwhile.

cemetery-escape.notes: No licence anywhere in the repository: all rights reserved, so it can't be redistributed.

zoridor.notes: Needs Zig 0.13 (the app's games use 0.15 and 0.17) and four more pinned dependencies, one of them a web server for its browser mode; not ported in this round.
